title: TenantGroupLocationSpecialty
description: Represents the specialty information for a group location.  References the Specialty entity.

startDate.description: The date when the specialty became effective.

endDate.description: The date when the specialty was terminated.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if the specialty is primary.

isBoardCertified.description: Indicates if the practitioner is board certified in this specialty.

isContracted.description: Indicates if the practitioner is contracted for this specialty.

isPractising.description: Indicates if the practitioner is currently practising this specialty.
